description: Countdown / time until a date — Time remaining until (or elapsed since) a date or datetime: weeks/days/hours/minutes, human phrase, calendar days, whole months, US business days excluding federal holidays (observed), weekend days and the holidays in between. DST-aware via IANA zones. Optional: tz (IANA, default UTC; date-only targets mean local midnight), from (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO datetime, default now). Offline. Price: $0.001 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: time_countdown
